fomod.Name: SkyParkour Together (Parkour Animations Sync)
fomod.Author: mailamea10
fomod.Description: Shares SkyParkour's vaults, climbs, ledge grabs, slides and landing rolls between Skyrim Together Reborn players, so everyone sees the same animation you play. Supports Skyrim 1.5.97, 1.6.1170/1.6.1179 and 1.7.104.
